description: Discover the 2016 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 LT, a versatile used pickup truck ready to meet your needs. With 148,981 miles on the odometer, this Tungsten Metallic beauty combines power and practicality. Equipped with a 5.3L V8 engine delivering up to 355 horsepower at 5600 rpm and 383 lb-ft of torque at 4100 rpm, it offers robust performance for work or play. The truck features a 6-speed automatic electronic transmission with overdrive and a 4WD drivetrain, ensuring reliable handling in various conditions. Its exterior boasts a sleek Tungsten Metallic finish, complemented by 18.0 x 8.5 in. Bright-Machined Aluminum Wheels and Xenon headlights for enhanced visibility. Inside, you'll find a Jet Black interior with leather-appointed seats, heated for comfort. The spacious four-door cab seats six comfortably, with features like dual-zone climate control, a rear-view camera, and a trailering package for added utility. Modern conveniences include Apple CarPlay, Bluetooth, satellite radio readiness, WiFi hotspot, and a premium Bose audio system. The 8-inch diagonal color touch screen navigation with Chevrolet MyLink brings connectivity and ease of use, making every drive enjoyable and efficient.This Silverado LT is packed with essential safety and security features. It includes four-wheel anti-lock brakes (ABS) for better control, anti-lockout power door locks for added security, and auto-locking locks to prevent unauthorized access. These systems work together to keep you and your cargo safe, whether you're on the road or parked. The combination of these features enhances the trucks dependability and peace of mind for daily driving or heavy-duty work.2016 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Safety and Security FeaturesThis model prioritizes safety with four-wheel ABS, anti-lockout power door locks, and auto-locking locks, providing comprehensive protection and security for you and your belongings. These features help prevent accidents and unauthorized access, making the Silverado a reliable choice for any driver.2016 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Entertainment and Technology FeaturesThe Silverado offers a suite of entertainment and tech features designed for convenience and connectivity. It includes voice-operated hands-free phone call integration and a radio with HD capability, accessible through an 8-inch touch screen display. The system also supports auxiliary audio input via USB, with six speakers distributing sound clearly throughout the cabin. Electronic messaging assistance with read function further adds to the modern driving experience.2016 Chevrolet Silverado 1500 Performance FeaturesPerformance-wise, this Silverado is equipped with an electronic hi-low 4WD selector and a part-time 4WD system with an on-demand setting, providing traction where needed. The rear locking differential enhances off-road capability, while cylinder deactivation helps improve fuel efficiency during highway cruising.
